title: Punjab Local Government Elections First Amendment Ordinance 2000

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Elections First Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE VI OF 2000
PUNJAB LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (FIRST AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VI OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Punjab Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 10th November, 2000]
No. Legis.3-VI/2000, dated
10-11-2000.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Local Government
Elections (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Elections First Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Substitution of, section 9 of Ordinance V of 2000

ORDINANCE VI OF 2000
PUNJAB LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (FIRST AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VI OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Punjab Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 10th November, 2000]
No. Legis.3-VI/2000, dated
10-11-2000.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:--
5. Substitution of, section 9
of Ordinance V of 2000.--In the said Ordinance, for section 9, the
following shall be substituted, namely:--
"9. Special
minority seats.--In a local area where the population of minorities is in
excess of ten percent. of the total population of that area, the seats
mentioned in the preceding sections shall be allocated in such manner as the
Government may determine."
